integrity: The arbitrary-dimensional theorem is proved analytically by character restriction and a complete local cube argument. The included verifier uses exact rational linear algebra and no floating-point tolerances.
scientific_limitations: Only exact four-point supports in \((\mathbb Z/2\mathbb Z)^d\) are classified. Larger supports, odd-characteristic groups, coefficient-orbit geometry, and phase information beyond zero/nonzero status are not addressed.
title: Four-sparse Walsh spectra are controlled by affine dimension on \((\mathbb Z/2\mathbb Z)^d\)
